description: This file contains unit tests for the AgentEventStore class, verifying appending, clearing, and trimming of events within the store.

classes.name: AgentEventStoreTests
classes.description: A test suite for the AgentEventStore class, containing test cases for appending events, clearing events, and trimming to maximum event count.

methods.name: `append and clear`
methods.description: Tests that events can be appended to the store and that the store can be cleared, verifying the event list is empty after clearing.

methods.name: `trims to max events`
methods.description: Tests that the event store maintains a maximum of 400 events by appending more and verifying that older events are trimmed.
